newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Kleinwort to up Raisio forecast.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Kleinwort to up Raisio forecast.

text.p: Kleinwort Benson analyst Michael Finney said on Wednesday profit prospects for Raisio's cholesterol-cutting agent Benecol in the United States would prompt him to raise earnings forecasts.

"I'm very impressed," he told Reuters after Raisio and its U.S. marketing partner McNeil made a presentation in London on plans for the product's U.S. launch. "They (the forecasts) will be upgraded significantly," he added.
He declined to specify current forecasts for the Finnish food group, but said the main factor in the upgrade would be earnings from the North American market in 1998.
Raisio said on Tuesday it and McNeil aim to launch Benecol in the United States next spring, earlier than some analysts had expected.
Raisio's stock has risen over 50 percent since Tuesday when it announced the deal with McNeil.
